payload.hypothesis: H1 residency-aware readahead, physical. xswap is SWP_SYNCHRONOUS_IO, so faults bypass readahead and read physically backed slots one 4 KiB bio at a time. Route an xswap fault whose slot has a physical backend through swapin_readahead, and read ahead only neighbours that are physically backed. Expected: lower sequential swap-in latency on xswap+disk; xswap+zswap unchanged. Regression risk: wasted IO and latency on random access. Falsifier: swapin_seq.mean_ns on xswap+disk not below baseline beyond calibrated noise, or a swapin_rand regression beyond noise.
